validation_purpose: Validate bounded human-supervised mosquito pilot operator dry-run usability, replay clarity, PASS/HOLD/BLOCK consistency, contradiction visibility, and operational comprehension before public exposure.

replay_clarity_review.survivability_assessment: operator can record decision reason, contradiction flags, next manual action, and replay reference from each simulated case

contradiction_visibility_review.survivability_assessment: missing location, conflicting details, unsupported area, and impossible guarantee signals remain visible to the operator

operator_comprehension_review.survivability_assessment: walkthrough remains short enough for manual operator use during dry-run review

pass_hold_block_consistency_review.survivability_assessment: simulated cases preserve PASS for clear bounded cases, HOLD for missing or contradictory inputs, and BLOCK for unsupported or impossible requests

operational_friction_review.survivability_assessment: manual actions are explicit and do not require automation, infrastructure activation, or runtime mutation
